notes.title: Developer Plays The One Who Stands Behind
The one who stands behind - Developers plays
notes.notes:
We are a team of two (and a cat) who have dedicated the last year to this project. Make some tea and explore with us the unique ideas and concepts, powerful cards, and power-ups the game has to offer!

Feel free to share your thoughts; we'd love to learn more about your vision.

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We've just published an update of the demo build!

The most important changes concern usability and UI, which was revised to reflect the feedback gained by our glorious testers. 

Also tutorial is much better now, and alot of bugfixes were done.

Enjoy the game and consider to leave feedback!
